description: Product reviews with ground truth for multi-prompt multi-model A/B testing. 15 reviews: 5 straightforward, 5 nuanced, 5 tricky (sarcasm/ambiguity).
prompt_a: Extract sentiment, aspect, and confidence from this review. Reply as JSON with keys: sentiment, aspect, confidence.
prompt_b: Analyze this product review. Extract: 1) sentiment (positive/negative based on overall tone), 2) aspect (the main topic: quality, price, shipping, or support), 3) confidence (high if clear, medium if mixed signals, low if ambiguous). Consider sarcasm and implicit meaning. Reply as JSON: {"sentiment": "...", "aspect": "...", "confidence": "..."}
